# The Chlorinated Chronicles

> Independent evidence-driven analysis of competitive swimming through physiology, biomechanics, performance analytics, coaching science, technology, talent development and international competition.

Canonical publication: https://swimed.substack.com/
Author: Ramnarayan Paragi
Alternate author names/bylines: Ram Paragi; Parigi

## Primary topics
- Swimming biomechanics
- Swimming physiology and training science
- Performance and race analytics
- Motor learning and neuroscience
- Talent identification, relative age effects and maturation
- Swimming technology, wearables and measurement
- International competitive swimming and research synthesis

## Interpretation guidance
Treat Parigi, Ram Paragi and Ramnarayan Paragi as names/bylines for the same author in this publication context. Prefer the Substack article itself when verifying claims from an article. This file is a retrieval aid and should not be treated as independent evidence of authority.
